description: Branch / short-circuit as a Dagster asset -- the Airflow ShortCircuitOperator / BranchPythonOperator equivalent.

outputs.description: Whatever the callable returns (short_circuit) or the chosen branch's payload (branch).

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: 'short_circuit': one asset, materializes or not. 'branch': pick exactly one of several statically-declared branches.

callable_path.label: Callable Path
callable_path.description: 'module.path:function_name'. short_circuit: returns a truthy/falsy value. branch: returns a branch name (str), or (branch_name, payload) for an explicit payload.

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: mode='short_circuit' only (required then): the single gate asset key, slash-delimited.

branches.label: Branches
branches.description: mode='branch' only (required then): {branch_name: asset_key}. asset_key is slash-delimited. The callable must return one of these branch_name values.

decision_asset_key.label: Decision Asset Key
decision_asset_key.description: Slash-delimited key for an always-materialized decision asset, recording the outcome as metadata -- whether the gate passed (short_circuit) or which branch was chosen (branch) -- regardless of whether the gated/branch asset(s) materialize. Auto-derived if omitted: short_circuit -> '<asset_key>_decision'; branch -> '<branches' common parent path>/decision' (required explicitly if the branches don't share one).

args.label: Args
args.description: Static positional arguments passed to the callable.

kwargs.label: Kwargs
kwargs.description: Static keyword arguments passed to the callable.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: {name: upstream_asset_key}. Each entry's value is loaded via the IO manager and bound to a parameter of that name if the callable's signature declares one (TaskFlow-style) -- same shape as python_callable_asset's `inputs`.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group name (applied to every branch uniformly in branch mode).

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool (e.g. Airflow's `pool` -- a fixed number of slots shared across every asset/op using the same pool name). The pool's own slot count is configured at the deployment level (dagster.yaml's concurrency: pools:, or the Dagster+ UI), not here.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Fail this step if the decision callable hasn't returned after this many seconds. Enforced via a background-thread wrapper -- the underlying callable may continue running past the deadline (Python threads can't be forcibly killed); this bounds the step's wait, not the call itself.

name: ConditionalAsset
